title: GS1 Domain Codelist
description: Human-readable names for each domain slug (e.g. 'rail', 'bearing', 'disco'), published as its own resource, analogous to sectors.jsonld and for the same reason: it changes far less often than the manifest and may be reused by other GS1 tooling. Publish at registry/domains.jsonld. The SPA fetches this at runtime and prefers its codeName over the manifest's own auto-generated DomainEntry.label wherever a domain name is shown; adding, renaming or reordering a domain's display name requires no SPA code change or redeploy, only an update here. Two shapes are accepted: a bare top-level array (preferred, matches sectors.jsonld's convention), or an object with the array under a 'domains' or 'sectors' key (the shape in use today).

oneOf.description: Accepted for backward compatibility with the current hand-authored file, which uses 'sectors' as the array key even though entries are Gs1Domain, not Gs1Sector. Prefer the 'domains' key (or a bare array) in new files.

codeValue.description: Domain slug, matching a DomainEntry.slug in the manifest, e.g. 'rail', 'bearing', 'disco'.

codeName.description: Human-readable display name, e.g. 'Domain Rail – Railway'.
